description: Class 3 (EXTERNAL_MUTATION) — the ONE filesystem seam: walks a declared mine root, hashes every admitted file under the declared CRLF→LF text normalisation, and emits a CaptureReceipt@1 (pack.builder shape) pinned to the mine's root hash. Read-only by construction: the mine tree is never written, and the single mutation is an append-only proposal row in the governed proposal namespace (D-409 SF1, un-retired) carrying the receipt plus a byte-identical read-back verification. Refuses by NAME: malformed payload, unpinned mine id, missing/!directory mine root, a symlink that escapes the root, an unreadable file, an empty mine, a pin that disagrees with the computed root hash, a law refusal, and a ledger that did not take the row. The capture-receipt refusals[] rows carry every entry excluded BY DECLARED POLICY (dependency trees, VCS metadata) with its named reason — an exclusion is a receipt fact, not a silent drop. The receipt is the proof of restraint; capture confers no authority, signs nothing, and commits nothing. D-409 split-plugin: the READ siblings (forge.mine.verify/diff/list@1) belong to the separate forge-mine plugin, never here.

contract.doc: capture {mineRoot, mineId} → CaptureReceipt@1 {schemaVersion, op, mineId, mineRoot, capturedAt, fileCount, rootHash, files[{path,hash,bytes,casRef}], refusals[{path,reason}]} — the ONE filesystem seam (Class 3: reading a foreign tree is the highest-risk act in the system). Reads the declared mine root only; never writes the tree; the receipt is appended to the governed proposal namespace and read back byte-identical before it is returned. rootHash = sha256 over the newline-joined `path:hexsha256` of every admitted file in path order — the pin the mine is replayable against. mineId MUST match MINE_ID and its digest MUST equal the computed rootHash (an unpinned tree is refused, not described). hashes are computed over CRLF→LF-normalised bytes so a receipt is a property of the mine, not of the reader's checkout line endings.

capabilities.justification: Reads a declared mine tree from the filesystem (the one declared seam; the tree is never written) and returns the CaptureReceipt@1 the pack.builder schema pins. The op's ONLY mutation is the governed append of that receipt to the proposal namespace — proposal-only in the strict sense: the receipt is a proposal record, it confers no authority, signs nothing, commits nothing, and is never read at boot. port:vault.get@1 reads the row back so an unsynced write is refused rather than trusted. port:law.check@1 is the in-handler self-check: the host already gates this EXTERNAL_MUTATION op through the forbidden-action overlay, and the self-check makes that claim machine-checkable from inside the plugin (a forbidden principal refuses before a single file byte is read).
